2607.29252.title: CalibratedRubric: Task-Adaptive Rubric Banks for Open-Ended LLM Evaluation
2607.29252.paper_summary: Reliable evaluation of open-ended LLM outputs requires fine-grained rubrics, yet expert curation is costly and difficult to scale. Existing automated pipelines rely on strict judge unanimity and binary variance filters, which cannot distinguish measurable rubrics from informative ones. We introduce CalibratedRubric, a task-adaptive framework that combines type-specific scoring, Bayesian rubric-measurability filtering, and item response theory (IRT)-based bank assembly. CalibratedRubric estimates each rubric's measurability with a Beta--Bernoulli agreement posterior and uses a submodular information-coverage objective to construct compact rubric banks over the observed capability range. Across financial, healthcare, general, and legal benchmarks, measurability filtering improves human-gold agreement on JudgmentBench from $κ=0.604$ to $0.743$. IRT-based greedy selection improves cross-fitted rank fidelity over random selection across all six evaluated response blocks and requires only 49 rather than 131 rubrics to reach the target correlation on FinResearchBench decision-support tasks. Task-label perturbations further reduce system separation, confirming the practical relevance of task-adaptive scoring. These results support CalibratedRubric as an efficient, uncertainty-aware approach to open-ended LLM evaluation, with calibration gains depending on sufficient judge redundancy.
2607.29252.paper_summary_zh: 可靠的開放式 LLM 輸出評估需要細緻的評分標準，但專家策劃成本高且難以擴展。現有的自動化流程依賴於嚴格的評審一致性和二元變異過濾器，這無法區分可測量的評分標準和信息性標準。我們介紹了 CalibratedRubric，一個任務自適應框架，結合了特定類型的評分、貝葉斯評分可測量性過濾和基於項目反應理論 (IRT) 的題庫組裝。CalibratedRubric 使用 Beta-Bernoulli 協議後驗來估計每個評分標準的可測量性，並利用次模信息覆蓋目標來構建觀察能力範圍內的緊湊評分庫。在金融、醫療保健、一般和法律基準中，可測量性過濾將 JudgmentBench 上的人類金標一致性從 $κ=0.604$ 提高到 $0.743$。基於 IRT 的貪婪選擇在所有六個評估的反應區塊中改善了交叉擬合排名的忠實度，並且只需 49 個而不是 131 個評分標準即可在 FinResearchBench 決策支持任務中達到目標相關性。任務標籤擾動進一步減少系統分離，確認了任務自適應評分的實際相關性。這些結果支持 CalibratedRubric 作為一種高效、具不確定性意識的開放式 LLM 評估方法，其校準增益依賴於足夠的評審冗餘。
